title: Is Cracking Your Neck Bad?
description:
Where did you learn it?

Cracking your neck doesn't grind bone on bone - the sound is gas in the joint fluid, and nobody has proved whether it's the bubble forming or collapsing. What actually matters is how far you force the turn, because the vertebral artery runs up through holes inside your neck bones.
